body.prompt: Create a clean empty background plate matching ONLY the scenery behind the interface of this reference: dark Russian fairy tale carved timber hall, antique wooden pillars at both sides, dim warm amber lantern illumination, shadowed dark blue stone floor toward bottom, painterly realistic game illustration.
